Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

Ab line ki doosri taraf dekho: wahan 7 marks hain, sab ek-doosre se barabar door. Us taraf kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door. Line ki doosri taraf wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
